StreetModels - street and exterior models for the night jewellery-store scene
Prepared 2026-10-14. Not yet imported or checked in Unity.

This folder mixes three licences. Per-file licence, source URL, mirror commit and SHA-256 are in sources.json.
  1. Poly Haven models: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). No attribution required; credits below are a courtesy.
  2. Daniel Zhabotinsky models: CC BY 4.0. ATTRIBUTION IS REQUIRED wherever the demo is shared (credits screen / docs).
  3. Project-made procedural models and textures: owned by this project, no third-party content.

CC0 1.0:   https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

===============================================================================
1. Poly Haven (CC0 1.0)
===============================================================================
Publisher licence: https://polyhaven.com/license, read from the site source github.com/Poly-Haven/polyhaven.com
@ b1a6aa13afc03ae00860f6ac5fe6d5daf8e95356, public/locales/en/license.json:
  "Our assets are all licensed as CC0, which is effectively Public Domain ..."
  "You can use our assets for any purpose, including commercial work."
  "You do not need to give credit or attribution when using them (although it is appreciated)."
  "You can redistribute them, share them around, include them when sharing your own work, or even in a product you sell."
polyhaven.com is not reachable from the build container, so the unmodified 1K glTF files were taken from public GitHub
repositories that ship them (each repository's own licence covers its code only). Where possible every file was checked
byte-for-byte against SHA-256 values that other projects recorded for the dl.polyhaven.org originals (see integrity_check).
Authors are from the Poly Haven API listing (copy in github.com/Akshay25798/VFX-Houdini-Asset_Browser downloads/json/models.json).

PottedPlant.obj, PottedPlant.mtl, PottedPlant_Leaves_Color.jpg, PottedPlant_Leaves_MetallicSmoothness.png, PottedPlant_Leaves_Normal.jpg, PottedPlant_Pot_Color.jpg, PottedPlant_Pot_MetallicSmoothness.png, PottedPlant_Pot_Normal.jpg
  "Potted Plant 01" by Rico Cilliers - https://polyhaven.com/a/potted_plant_01 - CC0 1.0
  Mirror: https://github.com/rawprogress/fable-cities @ aea8b1035030952555395de0c1de14ba693a1427, public/assets/shared/models/potted_plant_01
  Integrity: no second copy found; the mirror's info.json names Poly Haven, Rico Cilliers and CC0 (matches the Poly Haven API listing)
  Changes: Revision 2026-10-15, rebuilt within the 6k small-prop budget (was 11,662 tris incl. 1,650 zero-area): leaf mesh split into its 182 parts; the 91 blades simplified one by one with meshoptimizer 0.22 (seam-aware, budget raised per blade until >= 90 % of its area is kept: 9-23 tris each) and made double-sided (2,362 tris); the 91 thin tubular stalks rebuilt as 3-sided, 2-segment tubes on their fitted centrelines with their measured radius (0.8-4.1 mm) and their own UV strip (1,092 tris); pot 5,440 -> 1,000 and stem 7,008 -> 425 with meshoptimizer; the 508-pebble layer (56,878 tris) replaced by a 72-tri domed disc mapped onto the photographic gravel patch that the Poly Haven pot atlas already contains; zero-area slivers (40) and duplicate triangles removed; the 30 stem slivers that the simplification had folded inwards (back-facing from outside, unlike the original stem) re-wound to match their vertex normals (Source~/fix_stem_winding.py). Total 4,951 tris. Source~/plant_split.py, simplify_adaptive.mjs, plant_build.py. Textures unchanged: Color/Normal/MetallicSmoothness from the 1K maps (roughness map, no AO).

ApartmentBlock.obj, ApartmentBlock.mtl, ApartmentBlock_CrownDark_Color.jpg, ApartmentBlock_CrownDark_MetallicSmoothness.png, ApartmentBlock_CrownDark_Normal.jpg, ApartmentBlock_Interior_Color.jpg, ApartmentBlock_Plaster_Color.jpg, ApartmentBlock_Plaster_MetallicSmoothness.png, ApartmentBlock_Plaster_Normal.jpg, ApartmentBlock_TrimStone_Color.jpg, ApartmentBlock_TrimStone_MetallicSmoothness.png, ApartmentBlock_TrimStone_Normal.jpg, ApartmentBlock_WindowFrames_Color.jpg, ApartmentBlock_WindowFrames_MetallicSmoothness.png, ApartmentBlock_WindowFrames_Normal.jpg
  "Modular Urban Apartments Facade" by James Ray Cock - https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_urban_apartments_facade - CC0 1.0
  Mirror: https://github.com/vincentyenn/interactive-portfolio @ 410905e7ca904beed3c4caf2e709bb53e9183db2, public/models/loft-city
  Integrity: geometry buffer (8,168,772 bytes) byte-identical to the dl.polyhaven.org hash in raisimTech/raisim2Lib @ 94cdaa6b66f31b61e45ee0dd1efcb2c46a9498b4, rsc/city/sources.json (SHA-256 of the dl.polyhaven.org files); the mirror's SOURCE.txt states the files are unmodified 1K Poly Haven files
  Changes: Kit simplified with meshoptimizer (270,045 -> 48,128 tris), 64 module placements assembled in Python (5 bays x 3 m, storeys 3 m, ground level +0.15 m), shell and interior planes added, merged per material: 24,410 tris (revision 2026-10-15: 105 zero-area triangles removed). Texture conversion as above. ApartmentBlock_Interior_Color.jpg (revision 2026-10-15, replaces flat vector-drawn rooms): 20 cells (5 bays x 4 storeys, top row = ground floor), each a soft-focus 75-degree perspective view re-projected from a CC0 Poly Haven interior HDRI (Lebombo by Greg Zaal, St. Fagans Interior by Morgan Evans, Empty Warehouse 01 by Sergej Majboroda) and re-lit for night by Source~/make_interior.py: daylight windows replaced by night glass, lamp pools and the photographed wall sconces as light sources, 2700-4000 K per flat, bloom, ACES-fit tone mapping; overlays per cell: sheer curtains, backlit lined curtains, Venetian blinds (one half raised), TV glow, dark flats lit only by street-light spill, four dark shops with exit-light/standby LED glows and a lit stair hall. 7 of 15 upper windows lit, 2 with TV glow. Grain added; 1024 x 1024 JPG.

===============================================================================
2. Daniel Zhabotinsky (CC BY 4.0) - attribution required
===============================================================================
Licence evidence: the license.txt that Sketchfab ships with each download ("license type: CC-BY-4.0 ... Author must be
credited. Commercial use is allowed.") and the licence field Sketchfab writes into each glTF (asset.extras.license).
Sketchfab is not reachable from the build container; the files come from the GitHub repositories named below.
All makes and marques are fictional; the parody badge atlases were not shipped (badge meshes removed), number plates were
replaced by a plain plate colour, and a film-quote slogan was painted out of the police livery.

Credit lines to copy (as requested by the author):

* This work is based on "80 American Police Sedan - Low poly model" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/80-american-police-sedan-low-poly-model-945fd09f513f4d1ab19b6388a7ea7323) by Daniel Zhabotinsky (https://sketchfab.com/DanielZhabotinsky) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Used for: PoliceCar
  Mirror: https://github.com/CloudDCrow/space-drive @ 8a7e7f1e17844877219670817b6d032a76a26b53, public/models/popo
  Licence evidence: Sketchfab license.txt shipped beside the model (license type: CC-BY-4.0) and asset.extras.license in scene.gltf
  Changes (PoliceCar): Converted glTF -> OBJ/MTL (node transforms baked, metres, Y up, forward = +X); textures resized to 1K/512 and re-encoded (Color/Normal/MetallicSmoothness); KHR_materials_specular ignored; trunk badges removed (parody marque atlas); number-plate texture replaced by a plain plate colour; a slogan painted out of the body livery (two places); 20,840 tris (revision 2026-10-15: 8 zero-area triangles removed).

* This work is based on "Ace '11 - Low Poly model" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/ace-11-low-poly-model-055ff8a21b8d4d279debca089e2fafcd) by Daniel Zhabotinsky (https://sketchfab.com/DanielZhabotinsky) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Used for: Hatchback
  Mirror: https://github.com/austencloud/flow-arts-composer @ bec387c891edf3b8d2fac0842e2e7c417470e033, static/models/flow-fest/cars/ace-hatchback.glb
  Licence evidence: asset.extras.license in the GLB (CC-BY-4.0); the mirror's CREDITS.md (CC BY 4.0, web-optimised copy: WebP textures, meshopt compression, light simplification); independent second statement for the same Sketchfab model id 055ff8a21b8d4d279debca089e2fafcd: github.com/scenemax3d/scenemax3d-desktop resources-basic/resources/Models/modern_hatchback/license.txt (CC-BY-4.0)
  Changes (Hatchback): Converted glTF -> OBJ/MTL (node transforms baked, metres, Y up, forward = +X); textures resized to 1K/512 and re-encoded (Color/Normal/MetallicSmoothness); KHR_materials_specular ignored; decoded from the mirror's web-optimised GLB (meshopt + WebP -> plain glTF + PNG); badges removed (the badge atlas holds parody marques); plates replaced by plain colour; body paint set to grey metallic; 15,588 tris.

* This work is based on "88 American Sedan - Low poly model" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/88-american-sedan-low-poly-model-8509a7f82665442592627940b7a1cfab) by Daniel Zhabotinsky (https://sketchfab.com/DanielZhabotinsky) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Used for: SedanClassic
  Mirror: https://github.com/josiahthr/FinalGame @ 9c3fb66495210c8b9dccc3b5f28ba7633d59af53, Objects/88_american_sedan_-_low_poly_model
  Licence evidence: Sketchfab license.txt shipped beside the model (license type: CC-BY-4.0) and asset.extras.license in scene.gltf
  Changes (SedanClassic): Converted glTF -> OBJ/MTL (node transforms baked, metres, Y up, forward = +X); textures resized to 1K/512 and re-encoded (Color/Normal/MetallicSmoothness); KHR_materials_specular ignored; source was in inches: scaled by 0.0254 and turned 180 deg so the front faces +X; trunk badges removed; plates replaced by plain colour; paint set to dark red; 22,549 tris (revision 2026-10-15: 37 zero-area triangles removed).

* This work is based on "Downtown Buildings Set - Low Poly model" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/downtown-buildings-set-low-poly-model-7378e7fb9c914c39880d9913a6f4e1d6) by Daniel Zhabotinsky (https://sketchfab.com/DanielZhabotinsky) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Used for: BuildingBrickCorner, BuildingBrickArcade, BuildingNarrowOffice, BuildingBrickResidential
  Mirror: https://github.com/Orchemi/threejs-lab @ 2bcbfee4539e745662980c48d4b721faeace1b31, public/models/test2
  Licence evidence: Sketchfab license.txt shipped beside the model (license type: CC-BY-4.0) and asset.extras.license in scene.gltf
  Changes (BuildingBrickCorner): Converted the selected building from the set (node transforms baked, metres, Y up); shared 2K atlases resized to 1K JPG and renamed DT_*; metallicRoughness maps (near-constant) folded into material constants; no vertex normals written (flat facades); 3,261 tris. Revision 2026-10-15: the Sketchfab export lost the opacity of the Maskedstuff atlas (opaque JPEG composited on black), so the fire-escape cards rendered as near-black slabs; Source~/masked_details.py rebuilds the alpha from brightness (max RGB ramp 8 -> 20, 3 -> 8 in the dim chain-link band; specks < 4 px removed), lifts thin wires darker than 40/255 towards 40 (gain <= 4), bleeds colour into transparent texels and saves DT_MaskedDetails_Color.png; the OBJ gets 228 back-face triangles (reversed winding, own vertices) for the masked cards: 3,489 tris.
  Changes (BuildingBrickArcade): Converted the selected building from the set (node transforms baked, metres, Y up); shared 2K atlases resized to 1K JPG and renamed DT_*; metallicRoughness maps (near-constant) folded into material constants; no vertex normals written (flat facades); 1,437 tris.
  Changes (BuildingNarrowOffice): Converted the selected building from the set (node transforms baked, metres, Y up); shared 2K atlases resized to 1K JPG and renamed DT_*; metallicRoughness maps (near-constant) folded into material constants; no vertex normals written (flat facades); 825 tris.
  Changes (BuildingBrickResidential): Converted the selected building from the set (node transforms baked, metres, Y up); shared 2K atlases resized to 1K JPG and renamed DT_*; metallicRoughness maps (near-constant) folded into material constants; no vertex normals written (flat facades); 1,682 tris.

  Police sedan, hatchback, 1988 sedan and downtown buildings by Daniel Zhabotinsky (sketchfab.com/DanielZhabotinsky), CC BY 4.0, modified.

===============================================================================
3. Project-made (owned by this project)
===============================================================================
Models: TrafficLight, Bollard, BikeRack, SignNoStopping, SignOneWayStreetName, StreetNamePlate, ParkingMeter, StormDrainGrate, WasteContainer1100L, BusShelter, PoliceLightBar.
Textures: Proc_PaintedMetal_*, Proc_Galvanised_*, Proc_CastIron_*, Proc_Signs_Color.jpg, Proc_Lightbox_Color.jpg.
Generated with numpy/Pillow/trimesh by the scripts in Source~ (proc_models.py, geom.py, proc_tex.py).
Sign lettering is rendered into Proc_Signs_Color.jpg and Proc_Lightbox_Color.jpg with Barlow SemiBold (SIL OFL 1.1, already in Prototype/ThirdParty/Fonts); the font itself is not included here. All names are fictional (Kestrel Street, Old Town - District 4, "City of Lights").
The build and fix scripts in Source~ (conversion, PottedPlant rebuild, AirconGrille and DT_MaskedDetails maps,
interior re-lighting) are project-made; they ship no third-party content.
Road-sign symbols follow the generic Vienna-convention designs (no-stopping disc, one-way arrow); no logos, brands or
real place names. Source~/Preview.jpg is a software render of the models in this folder.
